description: This PHP class 'SugarFieldCronSchedule' extends 'SugarFieldBase' and manages the setup for cron schedule fields in a SugarCRM module, including generating days, weekdays, and time options for UI display.

classes.name: SugarFieldCronSchedule
classes.description: Handles the setup of schedule-related dropdowns (days, weekdays, hours, minutes) for cron scheduling in SugarCRM.

methods.name: getDays
methods.description: Generates an array of day numbers with ordinal suffixes for a month.

methods.name: getWeekDays
methods.description: Returns an array of abbreviated weekday names.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the schedule dropdown options and assigns them to the view.

methods.name: padNumbers
methods.description: Pads a number with a leading zero for display purposes.

methods.name: getDays
methods.description: Generates an array of day numbers with ordinal suffixes for a month starting from May 1, 1986.

methods.name: getWeekDays
methods.description: Returns an array of abbreviated weekday names starting from May 4, 1986.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering cron schedule options in the UI, including days, weekdays, hours, and minutes.

methods.name: padNumbers
methods.description: Pads single-digit numbers with a leading zero.
